decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggression and utilizing a blend of black and white cards in combination with blue for control elements. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with cheap creatures and disruptive spells, while maintaining card advantage with draw spells like Stock Up and Meticulous Archive. Optimistic Scavenger and Stormchaser's Talent help increase the deck's tempo, while cards like Fear of Isolation and Nurturing Pixie provide additional value. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while also having the ability to disrupt their game plan.

The main focus of this Dimir Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board early on with efficient removal spells and disruptive creatures, while also utilizing card draw and evasion to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and quickly close out the game with evasive threats and efficient removal spells. It combines the elements of aggression and disruption to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through a combination of aggression and control.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm and outrun the opponent with a mix of low-cost, high-impact creatures and burn spells. By focusing on aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Questing Druid, and Emberheart Challenger, combined with efficient burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Supporting cards like Witchstalker Frenzy and Soulstone Sanctuary provide additional benefits to keep the pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for fast and explosive starts.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of creature removal, counterspells, and resource denial. It utilizes a mix of powerful creatures like Overlord of the Hauntwoods and Overlord of the Mistmoors to establish board presence, while using spells like Get Lost and Day of Judgment to control the opponent's board. Leyline Binding and Zur, Eternal Schemer provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Floodfarm Verge and Sunfall generate additional resources. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.
